newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma makes a detour, firms in late dealing.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma makes a detour, firms in late dealing.

text.p: The drachma reversed course and slid against the ecu on purchases of 100 to 120 million ecus for drachmas at the fixing and implied drachma rates from forex forwards bounced 10 basis points across the spectrum, dealers said.
"The event of the day has been the slide of the drachma against the ecu," said a dealer at a foreign bank. "The ecu gained 1.5 drachmas on purchases of 100 to 120 million ecus at the fixing."

Ecu/drachma was trading off intraday highs at 304.15/25 in late trade and dealers said the excessive volatility at the fixing underlined the central bank's more flexible forex policy aiming at discouraging short-term speculative flows while retaining its anti-inflationary character.

Implied drachma rates from forex forwards firmed about 10 basis points across-the-board in thin dealing on a changing market view of the central bank's intention to slash its overnight intervention bid.

"The market has priced in a hefty overnight intervention rate cut by the central bank and seems to have second thoughts about it partly due to press reports that the central bank is not happy with recent depo rate cuts by commercial banks," a dealer said.
Bank of Greece soaked overnight cash at an unchanged 12.40 percent.
Bond dealers reported modest activity in tax-free three-year coupon bonds and FRNs due 2003 with prices firming further.
The mark was quoted at 156.60/70 drachmas from Monday's 156.900 fix, the dollar at 248.74/84 drachmas from 248.080 and the Ecu at 303.34/44 from 304.700 drachmas.
